note: Thirty-three measured regions over nineteen of thirty pages, and they resolve into 22 figure rows, 9 printed tables and 2 exclusions on the summary sheet, with no unresolved and no declared gaps. Families: 11 `flowchart-or-schematic` (the p4 roadmap, the two-lane strips of Figures 2, 4, 6, 7, 15, 16 and 18, the freeway schematic of Figure 5 and the two decision flowcharts of Figures 8 and 9), 6 `line` (Figure 3's three-series state plot, the radar of Figure 17 and the four two-curve comparisons of Figures 19 to 22), 5 `scatter` (Figures 10 to 14, blue dots under a red fitted curve) and 9 `table-grid`, so 22 figures and 9 tables average 10.3 exhibits over the nineteen density pages and just over one per page across the whole paper. Every caption survives in the text layer here, so none is typed from the crop, and the numbering is flat with a colon throughout. The radar of Figure 17 is the one shape the enum does not name: it is recorded `line` on the same call made for page 9 of P-A-2022-2209466-5952dd05, with its five spokes, ring gridlines and outside-right key stated in `other_note`. Faults worth carrying downstream: Figure 2's caption is corrupted to 'overtaking(i¡j)', Figures 15 and 16 are called printscreens though they are drawn strips, Figure 18's caption promises both traffic systems but the art illustrates only New Rule 2, Table 1 prints 'Traffic flow)' with a stray parenthesis, and Table 9's first column is headed 'Traffic Rule' over the composite index.
rules: The paper numbers its exhibits flatly and with a colon - 'Figure 1:' to 'Figure 22:' and 'Table 1:' to 'Table 9:' - so the colon forms fit every record and no exhibit is numbered 'Fig' [caption.numbering].
Every figure caption prints BELOW its art and every table caption ABOVE its grid, and the positions are recorded as printed [caption.position].
Pages 17 and 28 each print two captions to a line, so each panel gets its own row and the fragment quoted for it is the one carrying its own figure number [caption.verbatim].
Figures 10 to 14 are the only `scatter` rows: blue data dots read off a raster paste with a red fitted curve drawn through them, five panels sharing one frame style [geometry.family].

Figure 17 is a five-spoke radar with four closed polylines and no rectilinear axis at all, so it is recorded `line` on the precedent of the radar on page 9 of P-A-2022-2209466-5952dd05 and its construction is spelled out in `other_note` rather than approximated by a family the enum does not have [geometry.family].

Figures 15 and 16 are captioned 'a printscreen of simulation' but the art is a drawn two-lane strip of green bars with a red direction arrow, not a screenshot, so both are recorded `flowchart-or-schematic` and the misdescription is kept in the note [geometry.family].

Figure 18 declares two panels - LHT and RHT - and the art sub-labels them 'New Rule 2 in LHT' and 'New Rule 2 in RHT', while the caption claims to show the two traffic systems in general [geometry.panel_count].

Legends sit inside the frame at a corner in all nine of the plot rows and outside at the right in the radar; the strips and box diagrams carry none, and the direction cross in Figure 18 is an in-figure annotation rather than a key [geometry.legend].

The two flowcharts print numbers - Figure 8 lists T=2000, S=1000, p1=0.3, p2=0.7, d=2 and 2×S in its parameter boxes - while Figures 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9 and 18 carry letters and expressions only [geometry.printed_numbers].

The three sensitivity tables share one construction: a full-width merged 'original value' row over four data rows, horizontal rules only, so all three are `booktabs` with `merged_cells` true and `zebra` false [table.merged_cells].

Table 1 is the paper's one dense grid - a rule after every body row and two internal vertical rules, but still no outer side frame - so it is `vertical-rules` like Tables 5, 6, 8 and 9, and Tables 5 and 6 carry a single separator between the label column and the data [table.rule_style].

The citations run both ways: Figures 10 to 13 are captioned on page 17 and discussed on page 18, and Tables 6, 7 and 9 plus Figure 17 are each cited one page before the page their grids or art are printed on, so those blocks carry a negative `lead_pages` [mention.lead_pages].

Tables 2, 3 and 4 are never cited by number anywhere in the prose; the only pointer is the p19 clause 'results are shown in following tables', a deictic reference printing no number, so all three blocks record that clause with an empty style list and count 0 rather than a figure the paper never prints [mention.first_page].
